rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for recommending the preferred option or way of doing something.

example.english: You should preferably leave early to avoid traffic.
example.traditional: 你最好早啲出門口，避開塞車。
example.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 bei6 hoi1 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this when the speaker is expressing a clear personal preference between alternatives, rather than giving a general recommendation.

example.english: I would preferably stay home and watch a movie rather than go out into the crowds.
example.traditional: 我寧願留喺屋企睇戲，都唔想出去迫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ning4 jyun6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 hei3 dou1 m4 soeng2 ceot1 heoi3 bik1
